past passive participle indicating what is taught

items.question: What additional characterization of Niśyeśī is declared to Aghora Bhairava?
premises: Niśyeśī is characterized as without limbs.
items.inference: Niśyeśī is additionally declared to Aghora Bhairava as being without limbs.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of niraṅgalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: O Aghora Bhairava, Niśyeśī is also declared to be without limbs.
